svg.aria-label: Why? Four questions deep. Why build it this way? Because it works. Why does it work? Because every part does one job. Why does that matter? Because simple parts can be reasoned about. Why reason about it? So I know it is right, not hope it is. Understand it, then build it.

svg.text: Asked until nothing is left to ask.

g.text: Because every part does one job.
Because simple parts can be reasoned about.
So I know it is right, not hope it is.
